findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 20 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 19 questions numbered 1-19; by section: 20.1 1, 20.1.1 2, 20.1.2 1, 20.2 1, 20.3 1, 20.3.1 6, 20.4 2, 20.4.1 1, 20.4.2 1, 20.4.3 3.

Theory parts cover Kekule's structure and X-ray data, stability and resonance energy, atomic orbital structure, nomenclature, reactivity compared with alkanes and alkenes, the general electrophilic substitution mechanism, bromination, nitration, Friedel-Crafts alkylation and acylation, electrophile generation, meta and ortho-para directors, side-chain oxidation and addition reactions. Numericals (resonance energy with new values, combustion masses, hydrogenation masses and heat) use new values, recomputed in Python. None repeats the exercise's descriptive questions. Book corrections followed: 152 kJ mol⁻¹, sp²–s C–H, [AlBr₄]⁻, balanced methylbenzene chlorination, KMnO₄ test limits, methylcyclohexane CH.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
